contexts.text: The interior Angels dwell more loftily, upon mountains, and the more loftily in the degree that they are more interior and perfect.
The (celestial) Angels for the most part dwell in more elevated places, which appear like mountains of soil: the (spiritual) Angels dwell in less elevated places, which appear like hills.
They dwell in the middle of the Society, more loftily than the rest.
They who have loved Divine truth from interior affection... dwell... in elevated places, which appear like mountains.
In the more elevated places there, are the Heavens.
a [end]. As they were in an elevated place, and thus inflowed into lower things...
1.2. They who are in elevated places are nevertheless in the lowest ones; (for) in a moment they were in Hell, although they had appeared in an elevated place.
